title: Recent advances of cyanine dyes in tumor theranostics: molecular modification, delivery strategies, and synergistic mechanisms
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25174-25196
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02819E, Review Article
Open Access

This review summarizes recent advances of cyanine dyes in tumor phototheranostics, focusing on molecular modification and nanostructure construction, delivery strategies, and synergistic mechanisms in integrated platforms for enhancing functionality.
